public-site.module.name: Public site
public-site.module.description: The public pages: what's on, a page for each production, the archive of past shows and the calendar feed.
public-site.settings.archive.public.help: When off, every past production, the list of past shows and archived seasons answer "not found". Current shows are unaffected, and turning it back on restores everything.
public-site.settings.archive.from-year.h: Past shows that opened before this year are left out of the archive. Leave it empty to show everything.
public-site.settings.listing.cancelled-v: Keep a cancelled performance on the production's page, marked as cancelled, until its date has passed.
public-site.whats-on.title: What's on
public-site.whats-on.description: Everything with a date still to come, soonest first.
public-site.whats-on.empty: Nothing is on at the moment
public-site.whats-on.empty-description: New shows appear here as soon as their dates are announced.
public-site.whats-on.none-match-descript: Nothing with a date to come matches every filter you chose.
public-site.archive.title: Past shows
public-site.archive.description: Everything we have staged, year by year.
public-site.archive.search: Find a show, company or person

public-site.archive.no-results-descripti: Try a different spelling, or fewer words.
public-site.archive.empty-description: Shows appear here once their last performance has ended.
